campbell.title: Campbell City Council — August 18, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council considered several administrative items, including selecting voting delegates for the 2026 League of California Cities annual conference and a resolution amending the agreement for city clerk services. The Council also considered a grant acceptance presented by the police captain on behalf of the police department, along with an update on governance related to the BART Silicon Valley project.
keyTopics: Selection of voting delegates for the 2026 League of California Cities annual conference
Resolution amending the first amended agreement for city clerk services
Grant acceptance on behalf of the police department
Update on governance related to the BART Silicon Valley project

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — August 19, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council took up a routine mix of business, including approving meeting minutes, financial reports, and several service contracts for janitorial work, landscaping irrigation, and GIS consulting. The Council also considered a contested appeal of the Planning Commission's denial of a 25-lot residential subdivision on Pierce Road, a new five-year law enforcement contract with the Santa Clara County Sheriff's Office, and various infrastructure and parking items.
keyTopics: Appeal of Planning Commission's denial of a 25-lot subdivision on a 72.45-acre Pierce Road parcel, including its Environmental Impact Report
Five-year law enforcement services agreement with the Santa Clara County Sheriff's Office
Contracts for Bellgrove Park playground replacement with SpecPlay and Playgrounds Unlimited
No Parking Anytime zone proposed for Chester Avenue and Arcadia Palms Drive
Purchase of electric equipment to replace aging gas systems at Warner Hutton House, Civic Center Theater, and Joan Pisani Community Center

los-altos.title: Los Altos City Council — August 25, 2026
los-altos.summary: The Los Altos City Council considered several infrastructure and facilities items, including replacing the History Museum roof, awarding a contract for EV chargers at the Maintenance Yard, and accepting completion of the Woodland Library Patio Expansion. The Council also held a public hearing on a resident petition to rename Lee Street to Tubman Street, and reviewed two housing development proposals involving condominium units on First Street and on Sherwood and Acacia Avenues.
keyTopics: Public hearing on renaming Lee Street to Tubman Street
Vesting Tentative Maps for new condominium developments at 349 First Street (19 units) and Sherwood/Acacia Avenues (33 units)
History Museum roof replacement contract with Diablo Roofing, not to exceed $147,500
Maintenance Yard EV Chargers construction contract with Bockmon & Woody Electric Co., not to exceed $363,220
Draft responses to Santa Clara County Civil Grand Jury reports on pothole damage claims and VTA's BART Silicon Valley Phase II oversight

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — September 1, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council met to approve routine meeting minutes and take up several administrative items, including vacating a public service easement on Cerro Vista, setting up new parking permit and time-limited parking zones, and hiring a consultant for executive-level work. The agenda was largely procedural in nature.
keyTopics: Vacating a public service easement at 15995 Cerro Vista
Establishing preferential permit parking and time-limited parking
Authorizing a consultant agreement for executive-related services
Approval of minutes from multiple August 2026 Council meetings

san-jose.title: San José City Council — September 1, 2026
san-jose.summary: The San José City Council took up routine business including approval of council and committee meeting minutes, as well as a purchasing action for concrete removal, replacement, and repair services. Council also considered approving free use of City Hall spaces for a graphic novel contest awards event, while an agreement amendment on household hazardous waste collection was pushed back to a later meeting.
keyTopics: Approval of City Council and Council Committee minutes
Purchase orders for concrete removal, replacement, and repair services
Free use of the Rotunda, committee rooms, and Council Chambers for the 2026 Graphic Novel Making Contest Awards Celebration
Household Hazardous Waste Collection Program agreement amendment with Santa Clara County (deferred to September 29, 2026)

mountain-view.title: Mountain View Youth Advisory Committee — August 31, 2026
mountain-view.summary: Mountain View's Youth Advisory Committee met to take public comments, do a team-building exercise, and get an orientation covering open meeting rules and the committee's purpose. Members also began brainstorming ideas for their work plan for the upcoming 2026-27 fiscal year.
keyTopics: Team-building activity for committee members
Overview of the Brown Act and Robert's Rules of Order
Discussion of the Youth Advisory Committee's role
Brainstorming session for the FY 2026-27 work plan

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — August 25, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: The Sunnyvale City Council held a special meeting on August 25, 2026, beginning with a closed session, followed by a public presentation later that evening. The presentation focused on an update to the city's CleanWater program.
keyTopics: Closed session (special meeting)
CleanWater Program update presentation

cupertino.title: Cupertino City Council — September 1, 2026
cupertino.summary: The Cupertino City Council met on September 1, 2026, and began with a report on items discussed in closed session. The agenda also included information for the public on lobbyist registration and reporting requirements under the city's lobbying ordinance.
keyTopics: Report out from closed session
Lobbyist registration and reporting requirements under City Municipal Code Chapter 2.100

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — August 25, 2026
santa-clara.summary: This Santa Clara City Council meeting was held in a hybrid format, allowing one councilmember to join remotely from India while others attended in person or via Zoom. The agenda excerpt provided covers logistical details about remote participation and public comment procedures rather than substantive policy items.
keyTopics: Councilmember Chahal's remote participation from Panchkula, India
Hybrid meeting format with in-person and Zoom access options
Procedures for submitting written public comment before the meeting

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — September 1, 2026
milpitas.summary: The Milpitas City Council, sitting as the Successor Agency Board to the former Redevelopment Agency, considered confirming which city officials hold official positions with the Successor Agency. The Council also considered a resolution to authorize the issuance and sale of 2026 Tax Allocation Refunding Bonds to refinance existing Successor Agency debt.
keyTopics: Confirming and designating officers of the Successor Agency to the former Redevelopment Agency
Authorizing issuance and sale of 2026 Tax Allocation Refunding Bonds

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto City Council — August 26, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The City Council reviewed a proposed strategy for retaining, expanding, and attracting local businesses in Palo Alto, along with a staff report on economic development activity for August 2026. Both items were presentations intended to inform the Council about ongoing economic development efforts rather than decisions requiring a vote.
keyTopics: Business Retention, Expansion, and Attraction (BRE/A) Strategy presentation
Economic Development Activity Report for August 2026
